target.title: fix(tlon): bound Memex upload JSON response read
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`uploadFile` in the Tlon extension called `guarded.response.json()` directly on the Memex upload endpoint. An oversized or malicious JSON body could be buffered without limit, leading to OOM while uploading media.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace the bare `.json()` with `readProviderJsonResponse` capped at 64 KiB. The Memex upload response only needs `url` and `filePath`, so 64 KiB is generous headroom while preventing unbounded memory consumption.

## User Impact

Tlon media uploads are resilient to unexpectedly large Memex upload responses.

## Evidence

- Added regression test in `extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.test.ts` asserting `uploadFile` rejects when the Memex upload JSON body exceeds the cap.
- Added real behavior proof at `scripts/proof/tlon-memex-json-bound.mts` that feeds an oversized JSON response through the bounded reader and verifies it rejects cleanly.
- Local run:
  - `pnpm test extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.test.ts` passed
  - `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.ts extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.test.ts scripts/proof/tlon-memex-json-bound.mts` passed
  - `node --import tsx scripts/proof/tlon-memex-json-bound.mts`:

```
=== Proof: Tlon Memex upload JSON response bound ===

PASS: oversized Memex upload JSON response was rejected without OOM.
```
